from functools import reduce
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in (7, 8)]
    rows = sorted({r for r, c in points})
    cols = sorted({c for r, c in points})
    def period(vals):
        diffs = [b-a for a, b in zip(vals, vals[1:]) if b > a]
        return reduce(gcd, diffs) if diffs else 1
    rp, cp = period(rows), period(cols)
    r0, c0 = min(rows) % rp, min(cols) % cp
    rlines = list(range(r0, h, rp))
    clines = list(range(c0, w, cp))
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (2, 7, 8))
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rlines)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(clines)-1):
            corners = (grid[rlines[i]][clines[j]], grid[rlines[i]][clines[j+1]],
                       grid[rlines[i+1]][clines[j]], grid[rlines[i+1]][clines[j+1]])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in (7, 8) and len(set(corners)) == 1 else fill)
